name: CYBERIA

keywords: cyberia, MMORPG, browser game, sandbox, pixel art, free to play

name: Cyberia
description: The domain that owns the game runtime, the Game Studio, the Cyberia Engine and CLI, world content and item bindings.

acceptedAnswer.text: Cyberia is a real-time tap-based sandbox MMORPG that runs in the browser, together with the tooling that produces it: the Game Studio, the Cyberia Engine and the Cyberia CLI.

mainEntity.name: What do I need to play?

acceptedAnswer.text: A browser with JavaScript and HTML5. There is nothing to install, and the game is free to play.

mainEntity.name: Do I own my items on a blockchain?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not yet. Cyberia is Open Alpha and its economy is off-chain: inventory, quests and coin balance are progress state. On-chain ownership is ItemLedger's, and it opens in a later phase.

mainEntity.name: Where does Cyberia content come from?

acceptedAnswer.text: From the Object Layer. Cyberia authors definitions through the Studio, but the canonical copy is written at the Object Layer authority, and Cyberia binds an item label to it.
